answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable identity bond before transacting. Admission to high-value markets is a bridge that only opens after the bond has aged through real audited work: fresh identities must wander through low-trust sandbox tasks where peers log and review behavior. An attacker spinning up thousands of sock puppets pays locked capital, waiting time, and a per-identity audit trail; a sable-black market for aged accounts collapses when transfers trigger re-verification and re-bonding.
